up: For the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649970, retrieve all exact activity measurements (where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null) along with the canonical SMILES of the tested compounds. Include the compound's ChEMBL ID, preferred name (if available), standard activity type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, and canonical SMILES. Exclude non-exact or null measurements.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM assays ass JOIN activities a ON ass.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649970' AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
